On this page

Response families ​

Specify the sampling distribution beside each response and use formulas for any of its parameters. Links are explicit: log(sigma) ~ 1 + x declares a positive scale, while sigma ~ 1 + x declares an unconstrained predictor.

Support and parameters ​

Choose support first, then a parameterization whose priors you can interpret. The terms reference lists every mapped constructor and the supported compositions.

ResponseFamily examplesParametersCommon explicit link
RealNormal(mu, sigma), LocationScale(mu, sigma, TDist(nu))Location, scale; degrees of freedomIdentity for mu, log for scale
PositiveGamma(shape, scale), InverseGaussian(mu, lambda)Shape/scale or mean/concentrationLog
ProbabilityBeta(a, b)Two positive shapesLog on shapes, or transform mean and precision
Binary/trialsBernoulliLogit(eta), BinomialLogit(n, eta)Log odds; trials are dataIdentity on the log odds
CountPoisson(lambda), NegativeBinomial2(mu, phi)Rate or mean/precisionLog
Unordered categoryCategoricalLogit(eta2, eta3, ...)Log odds against the first levelIdentity on each log odds
Ordered categoryOrdinal(Cumulative(), ProbitLink(), eta)Predictor and inferred thresholdsLink supplied by the tag
DirectionCircularVonMises(mu, kappa)Direction and concentrationIdentity for direction, log for concentration
Joint real vectorMvNormalCholesky([mu1, mu2], L)Mean vector, covariance factorIdentity for means

Julia's Exponential and Gamma arguments are scales. BRM converts them to Stan's rate convention when emitting Stan. NormalCanon(eta, lambda) uses precision, NegativeBinomial2(mu, phi) has variance mu + mu^2 / phi, and the scale in a Student-t model is not its standard deviation.

This model uses one covariate in a real-valued measurement and a positive waiting time. Each response has its own distributional predictors.

julia
model = (@brm begin
    mu ~ 1 + x
    log(sigma) ~ 1
    log(wait_mean) ~ 1 + x
    y ~ Normal(mu, sigma)
    waiting ~ InverseGaussian(wait_mean, concentration)

    effect(mu, :) ~ Normal(0, 1)
    effect(sigma, Intercept) ~ Normal(-1, 0.5)
    effect(wait_mean, :) ~ Normal(0, 0.5)
    concentration ~ Exponential(1)
end)((; x=[-1., 0., 1.], y=[-0.2, 0.4, 0.8], waiting=[0.5, 0.9, 1.8]))

begin
    X_mu = hcat(rep_vector(1.0, num_elements(x)), x)
    pop_mu ~ _popefs_normal_coefs(; X = X_mu, beta_loc = [0, 0], beta_scale = [1, 1])
    X_log_sigma = hcat(rep_vector(1.0, num_elements(y)))
    pop_log_sigma ~ _popefs_normal(; X = X_log_sigma, beta_loc = [-1], beta_scale = [0.5])
    log_sigma = pop_log_sigma
    sigma = exp(log_sigma)
    X_log_wait_mean = hcat(rep_vector(1.0, num_elements(x)), x)
    pop_log_wait_mean ~ _popefs_normal(; X = X_log_wait_mean, beta_loc = [0, 0], beta_scale = [0.5, 0.5])
    log_wait_mean = pop_log_wait_mean
    wait_mean = exp(log_wait_mean)
    y ~ normal_id_glm(X_mu, 0.0, pop_mu, sigma)
    mu = X_mu * pop_mu
    concentration ~ exponential(1.0 ./ 1)
    waiting ~ brm_inverse_gaussian(wait_mean, concentration)
end
julia
"""
Population-level effects: one coefficient per column of the design matrix `X`.

Draws `beta_pop[1:ncoef] ~ Normal(loc, scale)` and returns the linear predictor
`X * beta_pop`. `ncoef` is the number of columns of `X`. Each prior argument (`loc`, `scale`) is one value for all coefficients or a vector with one per coefficient.
"""
brm_population_effects(X, ncoef, loc, scale) = begin
        beta_pop[1:ncoef] .~ Normal.(loc, scale)
        return X * beta_pop
    end

"""
Population-level effects of several predictors that share one design matrix `X`.

Draws one coefficient per column of `X` and predictor,
`beta_pop[1:ncoef, 1:ntargets] ~ Normal(loc, scale)`, and returns the
linear predictors `X * beta_pop`, one column per predictor.
"""
brm_joint_population_effects(X, ncoef, ntargets, loc, scale) = begin
        beta_pop[1:ncoef, 1:ntargets] .~ Normal.(loc, scale)
        return X * beta_pop
    end

begin
    X_Intercept_x = hcat(ones(length(x)), x)
    pop_Intercept_x ~ brm_joint_population_effects(X_Intercept_x, 2, 2, 0.0, hcat([1.0, 1.0], [0.5, 0.5]))
    pop_mu = pop_Intercept_x[:, 1]
    mu = pop_mu
    sigma_Intercept ~ Normal(-1.0, 0.5)
    log_sigma = sigma_Intercept
    sigma = exp.(log_sigma)
    pop_log_wait_mean = pop_Intercept_x[:, 2]
    log_wait_mean = pop_log_wait_mean
    wait_mean = exp.(log_wait_mean)
    concentration ~ Exponential(1.0)
    y .~ Normal.(mu, exp.(log_sigma))
    waiting .~ InverseGaussian.(exp.(log_wait_mean), concentration)
end

functions {
matrix hcat(
    vector x,
    vector y
) {
    int n = dims(x)[1];
    if (dims(y)[1] != n) reject("hcat: dim mismatch — `y` dim 1 (= ", dims(y)[1], ") does not match `n` (= ", n, "), inferred from `x` dim 1. `n` sizes: `x` dim 1 (= ", dims(x)[1], "), `y` dim 1 (= ", dims(y)[1], ").");
    return append_col(x, y);
}
matrix hcat(vector x) {
    int n = dims(x)[1];
    return to_matrix(x, n, 1);
}
vector normal_id_glm_lpdfs(
    vector y,
    matrix X,
    real alpha,
    vector beta,
    vector sigma
) {
    int n = dims(y)[1];
    if (dims(X)[1] != n) reject("normal_id_glm_lpdfs: dim mismatch — `X` dim 1 (= ", dims(X)[1], ") does not match `n` (= ", n, "), inferred from `y` dim 1. `n` sizes: `y` dim 1 (= ", dims(y)[1], "), `X` dim 1 (= ", dims(X)[1], ").");
    vector[n] rv;
    for(i in 1:n) {
        rv[i] = normal_lpdf(y[i] | (alpha + (X[i, :] * beta)), sigma);
    }
    return rv;
}
vector normal_id_glm_vector_rng(
    int anontok__1,
    matrix X,
    real alpha,
    vector beta,
    vector sigma
) {
    int m = anontok__1;
    if (dims(X)[1] != m) reject("normal_id_glm_rng: dim mismatch — `X` dim 1 (= ", dims(X)[1], ") does not match `m` (= ", m, "), inferred from `anontok__1` dim 1. `m` sizes: `anontok__1` dim 1 (= ", anontok__1, "), `X` dim 1 (= ", dims(X)[1], ").");
    if((m == 0)) {
        vector[m] rv;
        return rv;
    } else {
        return normal_id_glm_rng(X, alpha, beta, sigma);
    }
}
vector normal_id_glm_rng(
    matrix X,
    real alpha,
    vector beta,
    vector sigma
) {
    int m = dims(X)[1];
    if((m == 0)) {
        vector[m] rv;
        return rv;
    } else {
        return to_vector(normal_rng((rep_vector(alpha, m) + (X * beta)), sigma));
    }
}
real brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdf(
    vector y,
    vector mu,
    real lambda
) {
    int n = dims(y)[1];
    if (dims(mu)[1] != n) reject("brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdf: dim mismatch — `mu` dim 1 (= ", dims(mu)[1], ") does not match `n` (= ", n, "), inferred from `y` dim 1. `n` sizes: `y` dim 1 (= ", dims(y)[1], "), `mu` dim 1 (= ", dims(mu)[1], ").");
    return brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdf(y | mu, rep_vector(lambda, n));
}
real brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdf(
    vector y,
    vector mu,
    vector lambda
) {
    int n = dims(y)[1];
    if (dims(mu)[1] != n) reject("brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdf: dim mismatch — `mu` dim 1 (= ", dims(mu)[1], ") does not match `n` (= ", n, "), inferred from `y` dim 1. `n` sizes: `y` dim 1 (= ", dims(y)[1], "), `mu` dim 1 (= ", dims(mu)[1], "), `lambda` dim 1 (= ", dims(lambda)[1], ").");
    if (dims(lambda)[1] != n) reject("brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdf: dim mismatch — `lambda` dim 1 (= ", dims(lambda)[1], ") does not match `n` (= ", n, "), inferred from `y` dim 1. `n` sizes: `y` dim 1 (= ", dims(y)[1], "), `mu` dim 1 (= ", dims(mu)[1], "), `lambda` dim 1 (= ", dims(lambda)[1], ").");
    real rv = 0.0;
    for(i in 1:n) {
        rv += brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdf(y[i] | mu[i], lambda[i]);
    }
    return rv;
}
real brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdf(
    real y,
    real mu,
    real lambda
) {
    if((mu <= 0.0)) {
        return negative_infinity();
    } else {
        if((lambda <= 0.0)) {
            return negative_infinity();
        } else {
            if((y <= 0.0)) {
                return negative_infinity();
            } else {
                return (
                    (
                        (log(lambda) - (1.8378770664093456 + (3.0 * log(y)))) -
                        ((lambda * (y - mu) * (y - mu)) / (mu * mu * y))
                    ) /
                    2.0
                );
            }
        }
    }
}
vector brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdfs(
    vector y,
    vector mu,
    real lambda
) {
    int n = dims(y)[1];
    if (dims(mu)[1] != n) reject("brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdfs: dim mismatch — `mu` dim 1 (= ", dims(mu)[1], ") does not match `n` (= ", n, "), inferred from `y` dim 1. `n` sizes: `y` dim 1 (= ", dims(y)[1], "), `mu` dim 1 (= ", dims(mu)[1], ").");
    return brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdfs(y, mu, rep_vector(lambda, n));
}
vector brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdfs(
    vector y,
    vector mu,
    vector lambda
) {
    int n = dims(y)[1];
    if (dims(mu)[1] != n) reject("brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdfs: dim mismatch — `mu` dim 1 (= ", dims(mu)[1], ") does not match `n` (= ", n, "), inferred from `y` dim 1. `n` sizes: `y` dim 1 (= ", dims(y)[1], "), `mu` dim 1 (= ", dims(mu)[1], "), `lambda` dim 1 (= ", dims(lambda)[1], ").");
    if (dims(lambda)[1] != n) reject("brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdfs: dim mismatch — `lambda` dim 1 (= ", dims(lambda)[1], ") does not match `n` (= ", n, "), inferred from `y` dim 1. `n` sizes: `y` dim 1 (= ", dims(y)[1], "), `mu` dim 1 (= ", dims(mu)[1], "), `lambda` dim 1 (= ", dims(lambda)[1], ").");
    vector[n] rv;
    for(i in 1:n) {
        rv[i] = brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdf(y[i] | mu[i], lambda[i]);
    }
    return rv;
}
vector brm_inverse_gaussian_vector_rng(
    int anontok__1,
    vector mu,
    real lambda
) {
    int n = anontok__1;
    if (dims(mu)[1] != n) reject("brm_inverse_gaussian_rng: dim mismatch — `mu` dim 1 (= ", dims(mu)[1], ") does not match `n` (= ", n, "), inferred from `anontok__1` dim 1. `n` sizes: `anontok__1` dim 1 (= ", anontok__1, "), `mu` dim 1 (= ", dims(mu)[1], ").");
    vector[n] rv;
    for(i in 1:n) {
        rv[i] = brm_inverse_gaussian_rng(mu[i], lambda);
    }
    return rv;
}
real brm_inverse_gaussian_rng(
    real mu,
    real lambda
) {
    if((mu <= 0.0)) {
        reject("brm_inverse_gaussian_rng: mu must be strictly positive");
        return 0.0;
    } else {
        if((lambda <= 0.0)) {
            reject("brm_inverse_gaussian_rng: lambda must be strictly positive");
            return 0.0;
        } else {
            real z = normal_rng(0.0, 1.0);
            real v = (z * z);
            real w = (mu * v);
            real x = (mu + ((mu / (2.0 * lambda)) * (w - sqrt((w * ((4.0 * lambda) + w))))));
            real u = uniform_rng(0.0, 1.0);
            if((u < (mu / (mu + x)))) {
                return x;
            } else {
                return ((mu * mu) / x);
            }
        }
    }
}
}
data {
    int x_n;
    vector[x_n] x;
    int y_n;
    vector[y_n] y;
    int waiting_n;
    vector[waiting_n] waiting;
}
transformed data {
    matrix[x_n, 2] X_mu = hcat(rep_vector(1.0, num_elements(x)), x);
    int pop_mu_n_covariates = 2;
    matrix[num_elements(y), 1] X_log_sigma = hcat(rep_vector(1.0, num_elements(y)));
    int pop_log_sigma_n_covariates = 1;
    matrix[x_n, 2] X_log_wait_mean = hcat(rep_vector(1.0, num_elements(x)), x);
    int pop_log_wait_mean_n_covariates = 2;
}
parameters {
    vector[pop_mu_n_covariates] pop_mu_beta_pop;
    vector[pop_log_sigma_n_covariates] pop_log_sigma_beta_pop;
    vector[pop_log_wait_mean_n_covariates] pop_log_wait_mean_beta_pop;
    real<lower=0.0> concentration;
}
transformed parameters {
    vector[pop_mu_n_covariates] pop_mu = pop_mu_beta_pop;
    vector[num_elements(y)] pop_log_sigma = (X_log_sigma * pop_log_sigma_beta_pop);
    vector[num_elements(y)] log_sigma = pop_log_sigma;
    vector[num_elements(y)] sigma = exp(log_sigma);
    vector[x_n] pop_log_wait_mean = (X_log_wait_mean * pop_log_wait_mean_beta_pop);
    vector[x_n] log_wait_mean = pop_log_wait_mean;
    vector[x_n] wait_mean = exp(log_wait_mean);
}
model {
    pop_mu_beta_pop ~ normal([0, 0]', [1, 1]');
    pop_log_sigma_beta_pop ~ normal([-1]', [0.5]');
    pop_log_wait_mean_beta_pop ~ normal([0, 0]', [0.5, 0.5]');
    y ~ normal_id_glm(X_mu, 0.0, pop_mu, sigma);
    concentration ~ exponential((1.0 ./ 1));
    waiting ~ brm_inverse_gaussian(wait_mean, concentration);
}
generated quantities {
    vector[x_n] y_likelihood = normal_id_glm_lpdfs(y, X_mu, 0.0, pop_mu, sigma);
    vector[x_n] y_gen = normal_id_glm_vector_rng(y_n, X_mu, 0.0, pop_mu, sigma);
    vector[x_n] mu = (X_mu * pop_mu);
    vector[x_n] waiting_likelihood = brm_inverse_gaussian_lpdfs(waiting, wait_mean, concentration);
    vector[x_n] waiting_gen = brm_inverse_gaussian_vector_rng(waiting_n, wait_mean, concentration);
}

"""Generated by ReactiveKernelsPPL.jax_source from a built @rkppl program; do not edit.

Data: X_Intercept_x, waiting, x, y.

Model documentation:

- `pop_Intercept_x`: Population-level effects of several predictors that share one design matrix `X`.
  
  Draws one coefficient per column of `X` and predictor,
  `beta_pop[1:ncoef, 1:ntargets] ~ Normal(loc, scale)`, and returns the
  linear predictors `X * beta_pop`, one column per predictor."""
import numpy as np
import scipy.special as ssp
from typing import Any

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import jax.scipy.linalg
import jax.scipy.special as jsp
from jax.typing import ArrayLike

jax.config.update("jax_enable_x64", True)

DIMENSION = 6
PARAMETERS = {"sigma_Intercept": {"start": 0, "stop": 1, "transform": "identity", "dims": ()}, "concentration": {"start": 1, "stop": 2, "transform": "exp", "dims": ()}, "pop_Intercept_x.beta_pop": {"start": 2, "stop": 6, "transform": "identity", "dims": (2, 2)}}
DATA = {"X_Intercept_x": {"dtype": "float64", "ndim": 2, "ragged": False}, "waiting": {"dtype": "float64", "ndim": 1, "ragged": False}, "x": {"dtype": "float64", "ndim": 1, "ragged": False}, "y": {"dtype": "float64", "ndim": 1, "ragged": False}}
INPUTS = ("unconstrained", "X_Intercept_x", "y", "waiting")
PREPARED = {"X_Intercept_x": {"dtype": "float64", "ndim": 2, "ragged": False}, "y": {"dtype": "float64", "ndim": 1, "ragged": False}, "waiting": {"dtype": "float64", "ndim": 1, "ragged": False}}
UNTRANSLATED = {}


def prepare_data(X_Intercept_x: ArrayLike, waiting: ArrayLike, x: ArrayLike, y: ArrayLike) -> dict:
    """The functions' data inputs, computed from the raw data once per dataset.

    Pass the data by the names the model reads them; a list of arrays is a ragged
    column. Call the other functions with the result: `f(u, **prepared)`.
    """
    X_Intercept_x = np.asarray(X_Intercept_x, dtype=np.float64)
    waiting = np.asarray(waiting, dtype=np.float64)
    x = np.asarray(x, dtype=np.float64)
    y = np.asarray(y, dtype=np.float64)
    return {"X_Intercept_x": np.asarray(X_Intercept_x, dtype=np.float64), "y": np.asarray(y, dtype=np.float64), "waiting": np.asarray(waiting, dtype=np.float64)}


def log_density(unconstrained: ArrayLike, **prepared: ArrayLike) -> jax.Array:
    """The log density a sampler targets at `unconstrained`, the packed unconstrained parameters (length `dimension(prepared)`), for the data `prepare_data` returned: `f(u, **prepared)`.

    The sum of `log_prior`, `log_likelihood` and `log_jacobian`.
    """
    X_Intercept_x = prepared["X_Intercept_x"]
    y = prepared["y"]
    waiting = prepared["waiting"]
    unconstrained = jnp.asarray(unconstrained)
    X_Intercept_x = jnp.asarray(X_Intercept_x)
    y = jnp.asarray(y)
    waiting = jnp.asarray(waiting)
    location_binding = -1.0
    scale_binding = 0.5
    ppl_prior_sigma_Intercept_log_scale = np.log(scale_binding)
    scale_binding_2 = 1.0
    ppl_prior_concentration_log_scale = np.log(scale_binding_2)
    def then_arm():
        return True
    def else_arm():
        raise ValueError("_array_prior_cells_mismatch threw")
        return None
    value = (then_arm() if jnp.concatenate([jnp.stack([1.0, 1.0])[:, None], jnp.stack([0.5, 0.5])[:, None]], axis=1).shape == (2, 2) else else_arm())
    value_2 = jnp.ravel(jnp.concatenate([jnp.stack([1.0, 1.0])[:, None], jnp.stack([0.5, 0.5])[:, None]], axis=1), order="F")
    ppl_parg_pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop_2 = value_2
    sigma_Intercept = unconstrained[0]
    u_argument = unconstrained[1]
    constrain = jnp.exp(u_argument)
    ppl_arrflat_pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop = unconstrained[2:6]
    pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop = jnp.reshape(ppl_arrflat_pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop, (2, 2), order="F")
    rkppl_arg_1 = jnp.exp(sigma_Intercept)
    pop_Intercept_x = X_Intercept_x @ pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop
    pop_mu = pop_Intercept_x[:, 0]
    pop_log_wait_mean = pop_Intercept_x[:, 1]
    def cell(y_2, mu, rkppl_arg_1_2):
        def then_arm_2():
            log_scale = jnp.log(rkppl_arg_1_2)
            def then_arm_3():
                return 1.0
            def else_arm_2():
                return rkppl_arg_1_2
            value_3 = (y_2 - mu) / jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(rkppl_arg_1_2 == 0, y_2 == mu), then_arm_3, else_arm_2)
            standardized = value_3
            value_4 = -0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi) - 0.5 * standardized ** 2
            standard_logpdf = value_4
            def then_arm_4():
                return 0.0
            def else_arm_3():
                return log_scale
            value_5 = standard_logpdf - jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(rkppl_arg_1_2 == 0, y_2 != mu), then_arm_4, else_arm_3)
            return value_5
        def else_arm_4():
            return -jnp.inf
        ppl_density = jax.lax.cond(rkppl_arg_1_2 > 0, then_arm_2, else_arm_4)
        return ppl_density
    ppl_pw_y_resp = (jnp.zeros(y.shape[:1], dtype=jnp.float64) if 0 in y.shape[:1] and pop_mu.shape[:1] == y.shape[:1] else jax.vmap(cell, in_axes=(0, 0, None))(y, pop_mu, rkppl_arg_1))
    ppl_lik_y_resp = jnp.sum(ppl_pw_y_resp)
    ppl_mu_waiting_resp = jnp.exp(pop_log_wait_mean)
    def cell_2(waiting_2, ppl_mu_waiting_resp_2, concentration):
        def then_arm_2():
            value_3 = 0.5 * (jnp.log(concentration) - np.log(2 * np.pi))
            log_normalizer = value_3
            value_4 = waiting_2 > 0
            def then_arm_3():
                value_5 = waiting_2 == jnp.inf
                def then_arm_4():
                    value_6 = -jnp.inf
                    return value_6
                def else_arm_2():
                    value_7 = log_normalizer - 1.5 * jnp.log(waiting_2) - 0.5 * concentration * ((waiting_2 / ppl_mu_waiting_resp_2 - 1) / jnp.sqrt(waiting_2)) ** 2
                    return value_7
                value_8 = jax.lax.cond(value_5, then_arm_4, else_arm_2)
                return value_8
            def else_arm_3():
                value_9 = -jnp.inf
                return value_9
            value_10 = jax.lax.cond(value_4, then_arm_3, else_arm_3)
            return value_10
        def else_arm_4():
            return -jnp.inf
        ppl_density = jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(concentration > 0, ppl_mu_waiting_resp_2 > 0), then_arm_2, else_arm_4)
        return ppl_density
    ppl_pw_waiting_resp = (jnp.zeros(waiting.shape[:1], dtype=jnp.float64) if 0 in waiting.shape[:1] and ppl_mu_waiting_resp.shape[:1] == waiting.shape[:1] else jax.vmap(cell_2, in_axes=(0, 0, None))(waiting, ppl_mu_waiting_resp, constrain))
    ppl_lik_waiting_resp = jnp.sum(ppl_pw_waiting_resp)
    likelihood = ppl_lik_y_resp + ppl_lik_waiting_resp
    def then_arm_2():
        return sigma_Intercept == location_binding
    def else_arm_2():
        return False
    value_3 = (then_arm_2() if scale_binding == 0 else else_arm_2())
    def then_arm_3():
        return 1.0
    def else_arm_3():
        return scale_binding

def log_likelihood(unconstrained: ArrayLike, **prepared: ArrayLike) -> jax.Array:
    """The log likelihood of the observations at `unconstrained`, the packed unconstrained parameters (length `dimension(prepared)`), for the data `prepare_data` returned: `f(u, **prepared)`."""
    X_Intercept_x = prepared["X_Intercept_x"]
    y = prepared["y"]
    waiting = prepared["waiting"]
    unconstrained = jnp.asarray(unconstrained)
    X_Intercept_x = jnp.asarray(X_Intercept_x)
    y = jnp.asarray(y)
    waiting = jnp.asarray(waiting)
    sigma_Intercept = unconstrained[0]
    u_argument = unconstrained[1]
    constrain = jnp.exp(u_argument)
    ppl_arrflat_pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop = unconstrained[2:6]
    pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop = jnp.reshape(ppl_arrflat_pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop, (2, 2), order="F")
    rkppl_arg_1 = jnp.exp(sigma_Intercept)
    pop_Intercept_x = X_Intercept_x @ pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop
    pop_mu = pop_Intercept_x[:, 0]
    pop_log_wait_mean = pop_Intercept_x[:, 1]
    def cell(y_2, mu, rkppl_arg_1_2):
        def then_arm():
            log_scale = jnp.log(rkppl_arg_1_2)
            def then_arm_2():
                return 1.0
            def else_arm():
                return rkppl_arg_1_2
            value = (y_2 - mu) / jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(rkppl_arg_1_2 == 0, y_2 == mu), then_arm_2, else_arm)
            standardized = value
            value_2 = -0.5 * np.log(2 * np.pi) - 0.5 * standardized ** 2
            standard_logpdf = value_2
            def then_arm_3():
                return 0.0
            def else_arm_2():
                return log_scale
            value_3 = standard_logpdf - jax.lax.cond(jnp.logical_and(rkppl_arg_1_2 == 0, y_2 != mu), then_arm_3, else_arm_2)
            return value_3
        def else_arm_3():
            return -jnp.inf
        ppl_density = jax.lax.cond(rkppl_arg_1_2 > 0, then_arm, else_arm_3)
        return ppl_density
    ppl_pw_y_resp = (jnp.zeros(y.shape[:1], dtype=jnp.float64) if 0 in y.shape[:1] and pop_mu.shape[:1] == y.shape[:1] else jax.vmap(cell, in_axes=(0, 0, None))(y, pop_mu, rkppl_arg_1))
    ppl_lik_y_resp = jnp.sum(ppl_pw_y_resp)
    ppl_mu_waiting_resp = jnp.exp(pop_log_wait_mean)
    def cell_2(waiting_2, ppl_mu_waiting_resp_2, concentration):
        def then_arm():
            value = 0.5 * (jnp.log(concentration) - np.log(2 * np.pi))
            log_normalizer = value
            value_2 = waiting_2 > 0
            def then_arm_2():
                value_3 = waiting_2 == jnp.inf
                def then_arm_3():
                    value_4 = -jnp.inf
                    return value_4

            return -jnp.inf

    ppl_lik_waiting_resp = jnp.sum(ppl_pw_waiting_resp)
    likelihood = ppl_lik_y_resp + ppl_lik_waiting_resp
    def then_arm():
        return None
    def else_arm():
        raise ValueError("[layout] packed length ≠ layout total: a packed point holds the coordinates of the binding whose layout packed it")
        return None
    value = (then_arm() if unconstrained.size == 6 else else_arm())
    return likelihood

def constrain(unconstrained: ArrayLike, **prepared: ArrayLike) -> dict:
    """The constrained value of each parameter, and of each requested value, at `unconstrained`, the packed unconstrained parameters (length `dimension(prepared)`), for the data `prepare_data` returned: `f(u, **prepared)`. Returns a dict, a submodel's values nested under its name:

    - `sigma_Intercept`
    - `concentration`
    - `pop_Intercept_x.beta_pop`
    """
    X_Intercept_x = prepared["X_Intercept_x"]
    y = prepared["y"]
    waiting = prepared["waiting"]
    unconstrained = jnp.asarray(unconstrained)
    X_Intercept_x = jnp.asarray(X_Intercept_x)
    y = jnp.asarray(y)
    waiting = jnp.asarray(waiting)

    pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop = jnp.reshape(ppl_arrflat_pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop, (2, 2), order="F")
    def then_arm():

        raise ValueError("[layout] packed length ≠ layout total: a packed point holds the coordinates of the binding whose layout packed it")

def dimension(prepared: dict) -> int:
    """The length of `unconstrained` for the data `prepared` (what `prepare_data` returned)."""
    return 6


def parameters(prepared: dict) -> dict:
    """Each parameter's 0-based `start`/`stop` in `unconstrained`, its transform and dimensions,
    for the data `prepared` (what `prepare_data` returned)."""
    return {"sigma_Intercept": {"start": 0, "stop": 1, "transform": "identity", "dims": ()}, "concentration": {"start": 1, "stop": 2, "transform": "exp", "dims": ()}, "pop_Intercept_x.beta_pop": {"start": 2, "stop": 6, "transform": "identity", "dims": (2, 2)}}

Counts and extra zeros ​

HurdlePoisson(lambda, p_zero) assigns probability p_zero to zero and uses a zero-truncated Poisson for positive counts. With ZeroInflatedPoisson(lambda, zi), the ordinary Poisson component can also produce zeros. These probabilities therefore have different meanings.

model = (@brm begin
    log(lambda) ~ 1 + x
    logit(p_zero) ~ 1
    eta ~ 1 + x
    count ~ HurdlePoisson(lambda, p_zero)
    successes ~ BinomialLogit(trials, eta)

    effect(lambda, :) ~ Normal(0, 0.5)
    effect(p_zero, Intercept) ~ Normal(0, 1)
    effect(eta, :) ~ Normal(0, 1)
end)((; x=[-1., 0., 1., 2.], count=[0, 1, 0, 4],
    trials=[10, 10, 12, 12], successes=[2, 5, 8, 10]))

"""
Population-level effects: one coefficient per column of the design matrix `X`.

Draws `beta_pop[1:ncoef] ~ Normal(loc, scale)` and returns the linear predictor
`X * beta_pop`. `ncoef` is the number of columns of `X`. Each prior argument (`loc`, `scale`) is one value for all coefficients or a vector with one per coefficient.
"""
brm_population_effects(X, ncoef, loc, scale) = begin
        beta_pop[1:ncoef] .~ Normal.(loc, scale)
        return X * beta_pop
    end

"""
Population-level effects of several predictors that share one design matrix `X`.

Draws one coefficient per column of `X` and predictor,
`beta_pop[1:ncoef, 1:ntargets] ~ Normal(loc, scale)`, and returns the
linear predictors `X * beta_pop`, one column per predictor.
"""
brm_joint_population_effects(X, ncoef, ntargets, loc, scale) = begin
        beta_pop[1:ncoef, 1:ntargets] .~ Normal.(loc, scale)
        return X * beta_pop
    end

begin
    X_Intercept_x = hcat(ones(length(x)), x)
    pop_Intercept_x ~ brm_joint_population_effects(X_Intercept_x, 2, 2, 0.0, hcat([0.5, 0.5], [1.0, 1.0]))
    pop_log_lambda = pop_Intercept_x[:, 1]
    log_lambda = pop_log_lambda
    lambda = exp.(log_lambda)
    p_zero_Intercept ~ Normal(0.0, 1.0)
    logit_p_zero = p_zero_Intercept
    p_zero = logistic.(logit_p_zero)
    pop_eta = pop_Intercept_x[:, 2]
    eta = pop_eta
    count .~ HurdlePoisson.(lambda, p_zero)
    successes .~ BinomialLogit.(trials, eta)
end

    real rv = 0.0;

    """The log Jacobian of the constraining transforms at `unconstrained`, the packed unconstrained parameters (length `dimension(prepared)`), for the data `prepare_data` returned: `f(u, **prepared)`."""
    X_Intercept_x = prepared["X_Intercept_x"]
    count = prepared["count"]
    _ppl_yf_successes_resp = prepared["_ppl_yf_successes_resp"]
    _ppl_nf_successes_resp = prepared["_ppl_nf_successes_resp"]
    _ppl_lchoose_successes_resp = prepared["_ppl_lchoose_successes_resp"]
    unconstrained = jnp.asarray(unconstrained)
    X_Intercept_x = jnp.asarray(X_Intercept_x)
    count = jnp.asarray(count)
    _ppl_yf_successes_resp = jnp.asarray(_ppl_yf_successes_resp)
    _ppl_nf_successes_resp = jnp.asarray(_ppl_nf_successes_resp)
    log_jacobian_2 = 0.0
    return log_jacobian_2


def constrain(unconstrained: ArrayLike, **prepared: ArrayLike) -> dict:
    """The constrained value of each parameter, and of each requested value, at `unconstrained`, the packed unconstrained parameters (length `dimension(prepared)`), for the data `prepare_data` returned: `f(u, **prepared)`. Returns a dict, a submodel's values nested under its name:

    - `p_zero_Intercept`
    - `pop_Intercept_x.beta_pop`
    """
    X_Intercept_x = prepared["X_Intercept_x"]
    count = prepared["count"]
    _ppl_yf_successes_resp = prepared["_ppl_yf_successes_resp"]
    _ppl_nf_successes_resp = prepared["_ppl_nf_successes_resp"]
    _ppl_lchoose_successes_resp = prepared["_ppl_lchoose_successes_resp"]
    unconstrained = jnp.asarray(unconstrained)
    X_Intercept_x = jnp.asarray(X_Intercept_x)
    count = jnp.asarray(count)
    _ppl_yf_successes_resp = jnp.asarray(_ppl_yf_successes_resp)
    _ppl_nf_successes_resp = jnp.asarray(_ppl_nf_successes_resp)
    p_zero_Intercept = unconstrained[0]
    ppl_arrflat_pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop = unconstrained[1:5]
    pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop = jnp.reshape(ppl_arrflat_pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop, (2, 2), order="F")
    def then_arm():
        return None
    def else_arm():
        raise ValueError("[layout] packed length ≠ layout total: a packed point holds the coordinates of the binding whose layout packed it")
        return None
    value = (then_arm() if unconstrained.size == 5 else else_arm())
    return {"p_zero_Intercept": p_zero_Intercept, "pop_Intercept_x": {"beta_pop": pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop}}


def dimension(prepared: dict) -> int:
    """The length of `unconstrained` for the data `prepared` (what `prepare_data` returned)."""
    return 5


def parameters(prepared: dict) -> dict:
    """Each parameter's 0-based `start`/`stop` in `unconstrained`, its transform and dimensions,
    for the data `prepared` (what `prepare_data` returned)."""
    return {"p_zero_Intercept": {"start": 0, "stop": 1, "transform": "identity", "dims": ()}, "pop_Intercept_x.beta_pop": {"start": 1, "stop": 5, "transform": "identity", "dims": (2, 2)}}

Categories and thresholds ​

A nested formula gives CategoricalLogit one predictor per non-reference level. Plain vectors use sorted unique levels; a categorical vector uses its declared level order. The first level has logit zero. Fitted levels remain fixed during replay. effect(choice, x) ~ Normal(0, s) addresses the nested formula's coefficients through the response: it sets x's coefficient in every non-reference level. On the ReactiveKernels backend the level labels are data, so responses that differ only in their labels share one program; the number of levels still sets the number of predictors.

An ordinal model supplies its location through thresholds, so its common predictor has no intercept. Cumulative() has ordered thresholds; StoppingRatio() has separate stage intercepts. Both accept LogitLink(), ProbitLink() or CloglogLink().

"""
Each value's position (1-based) in `level_values`: the level codes of a grouping or factor.
"""
ReactiveKernels.@kernel(brm_prepared_indices(values, level_values) = begin
            indices = ReactiveKernels.plate(values) do value
                    Int(findfirst(isequal(value), level_values))
                end
            return indices
        end)

"""
Population-level effects: one coefficient per column of the design matrix `X`.

Draws `beta_pop[1:ncoef] ~ Normal(loc, scale)` and returns the linear predictor
`X * beta_pop`. `ncoef` is the number of columns of `X`. Each prior argument (`loc`, `scale`) is one value for all coefficients or a vector with one per coefficient.
"""
brm_population_effects(X, ncoef, loc, scale) = begin
        beta_pop[1:ncoef] .~ Normal.(loc, scale)
        return X * beta_pop
    end

"""
Population-level effects of several predictors that share one design matrix `X`.

Draws one coefficient per column of `X` and predictor,
`beta_pop[1:ncoef, 1:ntargets] ~ Normal(loc, scale)`, and returns the
linear predictors `X * beta_pop`, one column per predictor.
"""
brm_joint_population_effects(X, ncoef, ntargets, loc, scale) = begin
        beta_pop[1:ncoef, 1:ntargets] .~ Normal.(loc, scale)
        return X * beta_pop
    end

begin
    choice_fit_levels = brm_fit_levels(choice_fit)
    choice = brm_prepared_indices(choice_raw, choice_fit_levels)
    rating_fit_levels = brm_fit_levels(rating_fit)

    X_Intercept_x = hcat(ones(length(x)), x)
    pop_Intercept_x ~ brm_joint_population_effects(X_Intercept_x, 2, 2, 0.0, 1.0)

    choice_nested_arg1_class2 = pop_choice_nested_arg1_class2
    pop_choice_nested_arg1_class3 = pop_Intercept_x[:, 2]
    choice_nested_arg1_class3 = pop_choice_nested_arg1_class3
    X_eta = hcat(x)
    pop_eta ~ brm_population_effects(X_eta, 1, 0.0, 1.0)
    eta = pop_eta
    rating_thresholds ~ Ordered(Normal(0.0, 1.0), 2)
    choice .~ CategoricalLogit.(choice_nested_arg1_class2, choice_nested_arg1_class3)
    rating .~ Ordinal.(Cumulative(), ProbitLink(), eta, Ref(rating_thresholds), 1.0)

real brm_ordinal_lpmf(
    int y,
    real eta,
    vector thresholds,
    real discrimination,
    int structure,
    int link,
    vector threshold_effect
) {
    int k = dims(thresholds)[1];
    if (dims(threshold_effect)[1] != k) reject("brm_ordinal_lpmf: dim mismatch — `threshold_effect` dim 1 (= ", dims(threshold_effect)[1], ") does not match `k` (= ", k, "), inferred from `thresholds` dim 1. `k` sizes: `thresholds` dim 1 (= ", dims(thresholds)[1], "), `threshold_effect` dim 1 (= ", dims(threshold_effect)[1], ").");
    int K = (k + 1);
    if((discrimination <= 0.0)) {
        return negative_infinity();
    } else {
        if((y < 1)) {
            return negative_infinity();
        } else {
            if((y > K)) {
                return negative_infinity();
            } else {
                if((structure == 1)) {
                    if((link == 1)) {
                        return ordered_logistic_lpmf(y | (discrimination * eta), (discrimination .* thresholds));
                    } else {
                        if((y == 1)) {
                            real z_first = (discrimination * (thresholds[1] - eta));
                            return brm_ordinal_logcdf(z_first, link);
                        } else {
                            if((y == K)) {
                                real z_last = (discrimination * (thresholds[k] - eta));
                                return brm_ordinal_logccdf(z_last, link);
                            } else {
                                real z_hi = (discrimination * (thresholds[y] - eta));
                                real z_lo = (discrimination * (thresholds[(y - 1)] - eta));
                                return log_diff_exp(brm_ordinal_logcdf(z_hi, link), brm_ordinal_logcdf(z_lo, link));
                            }
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    real rv = 0.0;
                    for(j in 1:k) {
                        real z_stage = (discrimination * ((thresholds[j] - eta) - threshold_effect[j]));
                        if((j < y)) {
                            rv += brm_ordinal_logccdf(z_stage, link);
                        } else {
                            if((j == y)) {
                                rv += brm_ordinal_logcdf(z_stage, link);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    return rv;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
real brm_ordinal_logcdf(
    real z,
    int link
) {
    if((link == 1)) {
        return log_inv_logit(z);
    } else {
        if((link == 2)) {
            return normal_lcdf(z | 0.0, 1.0);
        } else {
            return log1m_exp((-exp(z)));
        }
    }
}
real brm_ordinal_logccdf(
    real z,
    int link
) {
    if((link == 1)) {
        return log_inv_logit((-z));
    } else {
        if((link == 2)) {
            return normal_lccdf(z | 0.0, 1.0);
        } else {
            return (-exp(z));
        }
    }
}

def log_likelihood(unconstrained: ArrayLike, **prepared: ArrayLike) -> jax.Array:
    """The log likelihood of the observations at `unconstrained`, the packed unconstrained parameters (length `dimension(prepared)`), for the data `prepare_data` returned: `f(u, **prepared)`."""
    X_Intercept_x = prepared["X_Intercept_x"]
    X_eta = prepared["X_eta"]
    choice = prepared["choice"]
    rating = prepared["rating"]
    unconstrained = jnp.asarray(unconstrained)
    X_Intercept_x = jnp.asarray(X_Intercept_x)
    X_eta = jnp.asarray(X_eta)
    choice = jnp.asarray(choice)
    rating = jnp.asarray(rating)
    ppl_vector_block_rating_thresholds = unconstrained[0:2]
    rating_thresholds = _rk_ordered_constrain(ppl_vector_block_rating_thresholds, 1, 2)
    ppl_arrflat_pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop = unconstrained[2:6]
    pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop = jnp.reshape(ppl_arrflat_pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop, (2, 2), order="F")
    pop_eta_beta_pop = unconstrained[6:7]
    pop_Intercept_x = X_Intercept_x @ pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop
    pop_choice_nested_arg1_class2 = pop_Intercept_x[:, 0]
    pop_choice_nested_arg1_class3 = pop_Intercept_x[:, 1]
    pop_eta = X_eta @ pop_eta_beta_pop
    def cell(choice_2, choice_nested_arg1_class2, choice_nested_arg1_class3):

def log_jacobian(unconstrained: ArrayLike, **prepared: ArrayLike) -> jax.Array:
    """The log Jacobian of the constraining transforms at `unconstrained`, the packed unconstrained parameters (length `dimension(prepared)`), for the data `prepare_data` returned: `f(u, **prepared)`."""
    X_Intercept_x = prepared["X_Intercept_x"]
    X_eta = prepared["X_eta"]
    choice = prepared["choice"]
    rating = prepared["rating"]
    unconstrained = jnp.asarray(unconstrained)
    X_Intercept_x = jnp.asarray(X_Intercept_x)
    X_eta = jnp.asarray(X_eta)
    choice = jnp.asarray(choice)
    rating = jnp.asarray(rating)
    ppl_ordered_tail_rating_thresholds = unconstrained[1:2]
    log_jacobian_2 = jnp.sum(ppl_ordered_tail_rating_thresholds)
    def then_arm():
        return None
    def else_arm():
        raise ValueError("[layout] packed length ≠ layout total: a packed point holds the coordinates of the binding whose layout packed it")
        return None
    value = (then_arm() if unconstrained.size == 7 else else_arm())
    return log_jacobian_2


def constrain(unconstrained: ArrayLike, **prepared: ArrayLike) -> dict:
    """The constrained value of each parameter, and of each requested value, at `unconstrained`, the packed unconstrained parameters (length `dimension(prepared)`), for the data `prepare_data` returned: `f(u, **prepared)`. Returns a dict, a submodel's values nested under its name:

    - `rating_thresholds`
    - `pop_Intercept_x.beta_pop`
    - `pop_eta.beta_pop`
    """
    X_Intercept_x = prepared["X_Intercept_x"]
    X_eta = prepared["X_eta"]
    choice = prepared["choice"]
    rating = prepared["rating"]
    unconstrained = jnp.asarray(unconstrained)
    X_Intercept_x = jnp.asarray(X_Intercept_x)
    X_eta = jnp.asarray(X_eta)
    choice = jnp.asarray(choice)
    rating = jnp.asarray(rating)
    ppl_vector_block_rating_thresholds = unconstrained[0:2]
    rating_thresholds = _rk_ordered_constrain(ppl_vector_block_rating_thresholds, 1, 2)
    ppl_arrflat_pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop = unconstrained[2:6]
    pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop = jnp.reshape(ppl_arrflat_pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop, (2, 2), order="F")
    pop_eta_beta_pop = unconstrained[6:7]
    def then_arm():
        return None
    def else_arm():
        raise ValueError("[layout] packed length ≠ layout total: a packed point holds the coordinates of the binding whose layout packed it")
        return None
    value = (then_arm() if unconstrained.size == 7 else else_arm())
    return {"rating_thresholds": rating_thresholds, "pop_Intercept_x": {"beta_pop": pop_Intercept_x_beta_pop}, "pop_eta": {"beta_pop": pop_eta_beta_pop}}


def dimension(prepared: dict) -> int:
    """The length of `unconstrained` for the data `prepared` (what `prepare_data` returned)."""
    return 7


def parameters(prepared: dict) -> dict:
    """Each parameter's 0-based `start`/`stop` in `unconstrained`, its transform and dimensions,
    for the data `prepared` (what `prepare_data` returned)."""
    return {"rating_thresholds": {"start": 0, "stop": 2, "transform": "ordered", "dims": ()}, "pop_Intercept_x.beta_pop": {"start": 2, "stop": 6, "transform": "identity", "dims": (2, 2)}, "pop_eta.beta_pop": {"start": 6, "stop": 7, "transform": "identity", "dims": (1,)}}

Observation mechanisms ​

Truncation conditions on being inside a sampling interval. Censoring records a limit in place of an unobserved value. An interval-censored response is the lower endpoint, and the likelihood is the probability of the interval (response, upper]. These are different observations of the same base law.

ObservationDeclarationPredictive quantity
Selected positive valuesy ~ truncated(Normal(mu, sigma); lower=0)Truncated values
Detection limity ~ censored(Normal(mu, sigma); lower=lloq)Values with the same clamping
Known intervaly ~ interval_censored(Normal(mu, sigma); upper=hi)Uncoarsened values from the base law
Partly missing continuous valuesmi(y) ~ Normal(mu, sigma)A latent value for each missing row
Known relative precisiony ~ weighted(Normal(mu, sigma), aweights(w))Normal SD sigma / sqrt(w)
Replicated or powered densityy ~ weighted(Normal(mu, sigma), fweights(w))Base-law prediction; density multiplied by the weight

The reference identifies supported base families. Response bounds may be data columns. interval_censored(x; upper=lloq) inside a predictor has a separate meaning: it imputes a censored covariate.

Mixtures and correlated outcomes ​

MixtureModel([Normal(mu1, sigma1), Normal(mu2, sigma2)], share) marginalizes component membership. Weights may be fixed, a declared Dirichlet simplex, or a valid row-dependent expression. The reference describes allowed component families. Stan can return membership probabilities as well as predictive draws; RK currently supplies the density, gradient and pointwise likelihood for this surface, but not mixture prediction.

For residual correlation, declare L ~ LKJCovarianceFactor(2; scale_prior=Exponential(1), shape=2) and observe [y1, y2] ~ MvNormalCholesky([mu1, mu2], L). This is a joint Gaussian observation per complete row. Non-Gaussian residual copulas and partially missing response vectors are outside that surface.

Continue to the Warfarin example for responses with different observation scales and a shared mechanistic model.
